# ip:country values the Tailscale control plane accepts, one per line.
# Provenance: captured live from tailnet example.ts.net on 2026-10-02 by
# provoking server-side policy validation with an invalid country:
#   pulumi env run example-lab/tailscale -- bin/tail-acl --file /tmp/posture-probes/vocab.hujson validate
# (probe posture: ip:country NOT IN ['AB']; the server's "valid values:" list
# was parsed into this file). The verbatim server error is preserved alongside
# in ip_country_vocabulary_raw.txt.
# The list includes XK (Kosovo) and deliberately has no ZZ: the Features/03
# write-up's ZZ claim did not reproduce against the live server. This file is
# the source of truth for the package's country vocabulary.
